dataset: CHAMP: Click-Based Determination of Accumulation of Molecules in Escherichia coli
role: permeability axis, training data for M3

license.name: CC BY 4.0
obligations: Attribution to the authors and the Zenodo record.

fetch_note: The /records/<id>/files/<name>?download=1 path returned HTTP 403 ('unusual traffic'), a temporary IP block rather than a policy restriction. The API content endpoint served the same file.

measurement.method: Chloroalkane azide membrane permeability (CHAMP): click chemistry readout of cytosolic accumulation
measurement.note: Direct measurement of how much compound reaches the cytosol, not a growth-inhibition proxy.

verified_contents.value_range: roughly 0..1, normalised; one missing value in the PS-DBCO column

why_this_dataset: Permeability and efflux appear as independent axes, so 'cannot get in' is separable from 'is pumped out'.
CC BY 4.0, unlike the CC BY-NC-ND alternative recorded in data/raw/sci_rep_2025/manifest.json.
Direct cytosolic measurement rather than a growth-inhibition proxy.
known_limitations: 1132 unique compounds is small: a scaffold-split test set is about 113 rows, so single-split numbers carry wide intervals. Report over many seeds with bootstrap CIs.
The paper develops the assay and reports no machine-learning baseline, so a baseline has to be trained here under matched conditions.
Assay differs from GramNegAccum (LC-MS/MS whole-cell); do not pool them for training.
attribution_required: CHAMP dataset, Zenodo record 17434251, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17434251, CC BY 4.0

evidence.why: accumulation in E. coli, the measured set this project's conditions are about.
evidence.caveat: no primary amine in 1,132 rows (measured 2026-10-14). A specification requiring one has no near neighbour here by construction, which is why the nearest-set comparison puts it far

nitrogen_counts_measured.control: the same detector finds 71 of 197 in GramNegAccum (36.0%), 2,756 of 22,051 in IMI-COMBINE (12.5%) and 2,322 of 17,775 in the ZINC -P slice (13.1%), so the zero is the data and not the test
